title.narrative: Palestinian Cultural Radio

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To promote Palestinian cultural expression and national identity and contribute to overcoming the geographical and social fragmentation of Palestinian civil society Specific Objective: To enhance the development of independent and critical cultural audio content and audio journalism especially in remote and marginalized communities in Palestine. Intermediate outcomes and outputs1)Cultural audio content, fostering civic engagement and critical thinking, developed and promoted 2)Capacity building program to enhance knowledge and skills of journalists, students, and cultural practitioners in audio journalism, including cultural reporting and critique, implemented 3)Opportunities for artistic and cultural expressions are provided through a radio bus and sub-granting for Palestinians, targeting especially youth and women from marginalized communities.

comment.narrative: Within Radio Atheer Art Residency Program Andrei Popoviciu who during his visit worked on producing a short narrative audio production with the help of four young Palestinians. Andrei helped each producer tell a story through a cultural artifact that connects them to their Palestinian heritage and what it means to them to be Palestinians. Toni Cutrone also known as Mai Mai Mai is famous for his incredible blend of Southern Italian Folklore industrial drone prototechno electronic music. During his residency Toni exchanged and recorded with local Palestinian musicians to learn and combine sounds and melodies from the heart of Palestine. This residency was held in collaboration with our partners from Radio AlHara and Wonder Cabinet in Bethlehem.Mai Mai Mais work lies in the intricate fusion of traditional instrumentation and electronic manipulation. By skillfully blending ancient melodies played on instruments like the Buzuq Arghul Oud and Nay with modular and analog synthesizers and electronic beats. Mai Mai Mai creates a sonic alchemy that bridges the gap between the past and the present.A Mediterranean Hauntology which far from being a simple nostalgic look noisily awakens those Ghosts it talks about and evokes them to accompany us in everyday life.

comment.narrative: Within Radio Atheer Art Residency Program Andrei Popoviciu who during his visit worked on producing a short narrative audio production with the help of four young Palestinians. Andrei helped each producer tell a story through a cultural artifact that connects them to their Palestinian heritage and what it means to them to be Palestinians. Toni Cutrone also known as Mai Mai Mai is famous for his incredible blend of Southern Italian Folklore industrial drone prototechno electronic music. During his residency Toni exchanged and recorded with local Palestinian musicians to learn and combine sounds and melodies from the heart of Palestine. This residency was held in collaboration with our partners from Radio AlHara and Wonder Cabinet in Bethlehem.Mai Mai Mais work lies in the intricate fusion of traditional instrumentation and electronic manipulation. By skillfully blending ancient melodies played on instruments like the Buzuq Arghul Oud and Nay with modular and analog synthesizers and electronic beats. Mai Mai Mai creates a sonic alchemy that bridges the gap between the past and the present.A Mediterranean Hauntology which far from being a simple nostalgic look noisily awakens those Ghosts it talks about and evokes them to accompany us in everyday life.
